### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, every trace contained A22, A31, A32, A37, A38, and A39 (each in 100% of traces). In the later window, A22 appears in about 45% of traces, and each of A31, A32, A37, A38, A39 appears in about 55% of traces. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006]
- A20's outgoing transitions changed: before it led to A31, A32, A37, A38, A39 (each roughly 17–24% of its outgoing transitions); after it leads almost exclusively to A23 (about 99.5% of its outgoing transitions). [DIR001]
- A21's outgoing transitions changed: before it led only to A22; after it leads to A22 (about 45%) and to A31, A32, A37, A38, A39 (together about 55%). [DIR002]
- The five activities A31, A32, A37, A38, A39 no longer have A23 as a successor; instead A26 appears as a successor for each of them. [DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007]
- A22 and the five activities are now almost mutually exclusive: before A22 co-occurred with each of them in 100% of traces; after, A22 co-occurs with each of them in only about 0.5% of traces, while A22 alone appears in about 45% and the five alone in about 55% of traces. [REL015, REL016, REL017, REL018, REL019]
- The order between A21 and the five activities reversed: before the five always preceded A21; after, when they co-occur, A21 precedes them in about 54.5% of traces and they precede A21 in only 0.5%. [REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011, REL012]
- Similarly, the order between A23 and the five reversed: before the five always preceded A23; after, A23 precedes them in about 54.5% of traces. [REL020, REL021, REL022, REL023, REL024]
- The five activities always co-occur with each other: before they were all present in 100% of traces; after they are all present together in 55% of traces and all absent together in 45% of traces. [REL030, REL031, REL032, REL033, REL034, REL035, REL036, REL037, REL038, REL039]
- Position shifts: A31, A32, A37, A38, A39 moved later (mean position from about 0.40 to about 0.57–0.58), while A23 moved earlier (mean from 0.48 to 0.38) and A21 moved earlier (mean from 0.62 to 0.53). [POS006, POS007, POS008, POS009, POS010, POS004, POS002]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a change from a single path to two alternative branches. In the earlier window, every trace followed a path where A20 led to a block of five activities (A31, A32, A37, A38, A39), then A23, then A21, then A22, then A26. In the later window, the process splits: about 55% of traces contain the block of five activities (without A22), and about 45% contain A22 (without the block). A20 now leads to A23 instead of to the block, and A21 now leads to either A22 or the block. The order also changed: A23 and A21 now occur before the block, whereas before the block occurred before them. This is supported by the large number of qualified items (72 vs 0.72 expected by chance), the consistent participation drops, the routing changes in DIR, and the mutual exclusivity shown in REL. A competing explanation that cannot be fully ruled out is that the two windows represent different case types rather than a temporal change, but the evidence is consistent with a structural change in the process.

Other differences: The position of A20 shifted slightly later (mean from 0.32 to 0.35) and A26 shifted slightly earlier (mean from 0.67 to 0.65), but these are minor and may be consequences of the order changes. [POS001, POS005]

Note: LAG items are based on only one trace in the later window, so they are not used for inference. [LAG001-LAG010]
